newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine 1996 growth seen as high as 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine 1996 growth seen as high as 4.5 pct.

text.p: Carlos Rodriguez, the Economy Ministry's chief advisor, estimated Argentina's gross domestic product rose between 3.66 percent and 4.5 percent last year.

"If GDP had risen the same amount in the fourth quarter as in the third, which was 6.6 percent, growth would be 3.66 percent, although that does not include an upward revision which will be made to the third quarter figures," Rodriguez told the daily La Prensa.

Rodriguez said a maximum but not impossible estimate of 10 percent growth for the fourth quarter would bring growth for the whole year to 4.5 percent. He added that the 3.66 percent forecast was "conservative."
The government recently upgraded its growth figure for the second quarter to 4.8 percent from 2.6 percent and promised it would also raise the figure for the third quarter from 6.6 percent.
